cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Calm About the Impossible
cards.instruction: Remain perfectly calm around impossible events while becoming increasingly alarmed by ordinary details.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Your dragon can stay for tea. Please keep the biscuit crumbs off my carpet. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: His three heads breathe fire. Should I take him outside?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. He's fine here. Wait, three mouths? I need three napkins immediately.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He brought his own. They're paper.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Paper? At my good table? Fetch the linen before the neighbors see.

mechanism: A hosts a dragon calmly, takes hospitality work and escalates alarm only over napkin count and material.
confusable: Unlike fear of the impossible visitor, fire never alarms A while ordinary social presentation increasingly does.
comparison: Dragon tea etiquette differs from keeping muddy boots off a floating table.
seedUse: D165-a three-headed dragon, paper napkins and linen; S02-a keeps visitor welcome by supplying the extra service.
